function: Joint channel estimation and data detection in the delay-Doppler domain of an OTFS link, using U-Net subnetworks for coarse estimation, detection, and data-aided estimation (p. 6).
system: Single-link OTFS with antennas not stated and no RIS; satellite at 1500 km, 2 GHz carrier, 330 kHz subcarrier spacing, 128x30 grid, 4-QAM (p. 13).
method: Supervised U-Net (CNN) subnetworks trained independently: MSE loss for channel estimation, cross-entropy for detection; AdamW, 100 epochs (pp. 6, 8, 11, 13).
data_channel: Simulated 3GPP NTN-TDL-D channel profile (TR 38.811) with Table VII parameters for training and testing; no measured data (pp. 13, 16).
test_conditions: Trained on NTN-TDL-D and tested on NTN-TDL-D; also tested on unseen NTN-TDL-A without retraining, and after retraining on TDL-A; SNR sweep 10-16 dB (pp. 15-16).
baselines: Classical: embedded-pilot threshold, OMP, SP-I, MF-OAMP; learned: DRDN [28], DRAN [32], DNN [33] (pp. 13-14).
metrics: NMSE of channel estimation, BER of data detection, spectral efficiency, FLOPs, parameter count, and execution time (pp. 12-13, 16).
complexity: FLOPs and parameters per subnetwork (Table VI, p. 13), big-O orders (p. 12), and execution time of 5.8e-3 s per frame (Table VIII, p. 16).
q1_support: p. 13: "we use the NTN-TDL-D channel model to construct the LOS channel profiles in the system"
q2_support: p. 15: "applying network weights trained on the NTN-TDL-D channel model to the NTN-TDL-A dataset"
q3_support: p. 14: "Both traditional algorithms and deep learning-based methods were considered for a fair evaluation"
q4_support: p. 12: "compared with existing methods in terms of floating-point operations (FLOPs) and parameter count, as summarized in Table VI"
q5_support: p. 16: "only simulation data is used for model training and testing"
notes: Area 4 rather than 6: the learned method works in the delay-Doppler domain of OTFS, set in an NTN scenario. q1: NTN-TDL-D is the 3GPP TR 38.811 NTN tapped-delay-line profile; p. 13 says the scenarios are 'recommended by the 3rd Generation Partnership Project' and Table VII cites [34], the 3GPP NR-NTN study (p. 17, printed 'Rep. 38.8111'). q2: weights trained on TDL-D, tested on TDL-A (Fig. 15 and 16 legends, p. 15-16). q3: learned baselines DRDN, DRAN, DNN are outperformed in NMSE (p. 14). q5: no code or data link in the paper.
